concept.literalSynthesis: A wand of vampire spark whose handle is wrapped in the dark, visibly stitched cloth of a vampire suit; a red ember glows through the seams and at the wand tip.
concept.coreMechanic: The wand fires one cursor-aimed magic ember at the source wand's 26-tick use rhythm. Each ember travels at 26.25 blocks/s, falls under 27 blocks/s² downward acceleration, deals 12 magic damage on contact, and vanishes on its first NPC hit or solid tile. A hit restores 10% of damage dealt, capped at 1 HP per hit. The item also works as an accessory: while equipped it grants 2 defense, +0.5 HP/s life regeneration, and +5% movement speed. The active shot costs 4 mana per new use animation; repeated mana payment is not guaranteed for additional activations within one animation. Source observations include a 12-damage, 26-tick, 4-mana blue-rarity wand worth 40,000 copper and a suit worth 60,000 copper with life regeneration and movement speed. The combined 100,000-copper value and retained blue rarity are design choices; no acquisition tier or recipe is supplied.
concept.parentAContribution: The vampire-spark wand identity supplies the glowing ember projectile and the purposeful ranged magic action. Its observed 12 damage, 26-tick cadence, 4-mana cost, 7-pixel-per-tick launch speed, 16-pixel forward offset, 90-tick lifetime, gravity arc, and on-hit capped siphon inform the shot; the speed, offset, lifetime, and gravity are authored here in current gameplay units.
concept.parentBContribution: The stitched vampire suit identity becomes the cloth-wrapped wand handle and the separate worn accessory mode. Its observed accessory life regeneration and movement-speed bonus inspire modest equipped regeneration and speed; positive defense is an explicit new effect requested for this design, not a claim about the source suit.
concept.playerExperience: Aim and fire a modest-cost ember for reliable single-hit damage and a small capped heal. Equip the same item for defense, regeneration, and faster movement. The accessory benefits require equipping; carrying or holding it grants no defense.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Aim at a target and fire one gravity-curving magic ember for 4 mana per new use animation; a damaging hit restores up to 1 HP.
Wear the item as an accessory for 2 defense, +0.5 HP/s life regeneration, and +5% movement speed.

realization.description: Use the wand to fire one red ember toward your cursor. It travels quickly, then curves downward; it deals 12 magic damage, disappears on its first enemy hit or solid wall, and heals you for 10% of damage dealt, up to 1 HP per hit. Each new use animation costs 4 mana and follows a 26-tick use interval. Equip the wand as an accessory for 2 defense, +0.5 HP/s life regeneration, and +5% movement speed. These bonuses apply while equipped, not while carried or held.
realization.playerExperience: The shot trades modest damage and a short-lived single hit for a small sustain effect. Accessory bonuses are independent of firing, so you can benefit from them while using other weapons.
realization.selfEvaluation: The item body is the sole primary entity; its active and equipped actions are separate bindings. Projectile damage explicitly emits on_hit for the capped heal. Gravity, projectile speed, and accessory regeneration use current author units, and the source suit's regeneration has been converted from its wire value.
